Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1242 PM EST Wed Nov 11 2026

- Light rain overspreads SE MI this afternoon and evening.

- A much colder airmass arrives Thursday, triggering gusty north 
wind and lake effect rain/snow showers Thursday through Saturday. 
Minor wet snow accumulations will be possible in the Thumb.

&&

.AVIATION...

A pair of lows will impact the region through the forecast period 
resulting in MVFR conditions and periods of rain. One low is 
tracking just south of the state line while a second low will drop 
SE through the state this evening pulling a cold front along with 
it. Overall we'll see deteriorating conditions with lowering 
ceilings and periods of reduced visibilities within areas of light 
rain. A west to east band of rain is setting up across Mid MI which 
will impact MBS and maybe FNT this afternoon, it fills in southward 
across the rest of the terminals this evening for a few hours. 
Ceilings will lower through the night to MVFR with the front pulling 
lower stratus and showers through Thursday morning. Light winds this 
afternoon will become more northeasterly this afternoon as the 
southern low draws near, and then becomes gusty out of the north 
behind the cold front for Thursday with gusts of 20 to 25 knots. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Medium for ceilings at or below 5,000 feet late this afternoon-
  evening. High tonight into Thursday morning.

&&
